title: Chop Chop
goal: Chop the tree as many times as you can in 30 seconds.
rules: Every chop takes a piece off the bottom of the tree.
If a branch drops onto your side, you are out.
Watch the branches and switch sides before they reach you.
controller: Two tap pads. Tap left or right.

title: Void Run
goal: Fly as far as you can and blast drones for points.
rules: Your ship flies forward by itself. Steer around the rocks.
Drones are worth 100 points and rocks 25.
Crashes and drone shots damage your hull. Empty hull ends the run.
controls: Hold to fire. Press to launch.
controller: Tilt stick. Tilt to steer, hold the button to fire.

title: Flappy Tungs
goal: Angel against devil. Fly further than your rival. First to 3 rounds wins.
rules: Both players stomp once to get ready, then 3, 2, 1.
Every stomp flaps your wings. Fly through the gaps in the spikes.
Touching a spike, the ceiling, or the ground puts you out for that round.
controller: Two foot pedals. Stomp to flap.

solo.goal: Race the devil, flown by the computer. First to 3 rounds wins. Your best distance goes on the board.
rules: Stomp once to get ready, then 3, 2, 1.
Every stomp flaps your wings. Fly through the gaps in the spikes.
Pass more gaps than the devil to win the round.
solo.controller: Use pedal 1 (the left one). Stomp to flap.

title: Dead Tape Gun
goal: Two players, one gun, six chambers. Best of 3 rounds.
rules: Each player has 3 HP. Some chambers are live and some are blank.
Aim at your rival or at yourself, then hold the trigger to fire.
A blank at yourself keeps your turn. Then pass the gun on.
controller: Tape gun. Tilt it to aim and squeeze the trigger.

solo.goal: You against the Stranger, played by the computer. One gun, six chambers. Best of 3 rounds.
rules: You both have 3 HP. Some chambers are live and some are blank. Watch the count.
Aim at the Stranger or at yourself, then hold the trigger to fire.
A blank at yourself keeps your turn. Beat the Stranger to get on the board.

title: Don't Press That!
goal: Defuse the bomb by following every instruction on the screen.
rules: Read the WHOLE instruction. Some of them are tricks.
When it says don't press anything, keep your hands off.
A wrong press costs a life. Lose all 3 lives or run out of time and it blows.
controls: Keypad A B C D (V is B)
controller: Bomb panel. Coloured buttons and a keypad.

title: Co-Pilots
goal: Two pilots, one ship. Work together to survive as long as you can.
rules: Player 1 steers left and right through the CYAN walls.
Player 2 flies up and down through the PINK beams.
Grab gold coins for bonus points. One crash ends the run.
controller: Tilt the controller to steer, buttons for up, down, and boost.

title: Two-Lane Tiles
goal: Hit every tile as it falls. It keeps getting faster.
rules: Press the lane that has the lowest dark tile.
Pressing the wrong lane ends the run.
Letting a tile fall off the bottom ends the run.
controller: Two tap pads. Tap left or right.

title: Four Key Tiles
goal: Play the falling tiles like a piano. It keeps getting faster.
rules: Press the key under the lowest dark tile.
Pressing the wrong key ends the run.
Letting a tile fall off the bottom ends the run.

title: Flappy Drone
goal: Fly the drone through as many gaps as you can.
rules: Each press gives the drone a lift. Gravity pulls it down.
Every gap you pass scores a point, and it keeps getting faster.
Touching a pillar, the ground, or the top ends the run.
